The '''2015 Minnesota State Team Tournament''' (3rd Annual State Team Tournament) was held on 25 April 2015 at Legion Games in Burnsville, Minnesota, and organized by [[Mark Walseth]]. 28 players on four teams played six games of modified match play in seven tiers. Team Rosemount won for the third year in a row.<ref name="st15">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=57158 3rd Annual State Team Tournament - Burnsville, MN], forum.starwarsccg.org (26 January – 27 April 2015). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004902/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t57158.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Legion Games, 3128 West Hwy 13, Burnsville, Minnesota<ref name="st15" />
* '''Date:''' 25 April 2015<ref name="st15" />
* '''Structure:''' Team tournament, 6 games of modified match play by tier<ref name="st15" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Mark Walseth]]<ref name="st15" />
* '''Field:''' 28 players, 4 teams<ref name="st15" />
